purpose: Curated public technical lookup over existing sources; not a new runtime, asset registry, company plan or private knowledge store.

scope.source_policy: Pointers to existing source authorities; source inspection is not proof of execution or acceptance.
limitations: Default-branch model paths exclude procedural objects and branch-only or historical outputs.
Source state and build/device results may differ; follow the pinned evidence scope.
Private cloud originals, source checkpoint, complete account inventory and workstation metadata are intentionally excluded.

records.title: KONA.m runtime and product tooling
records.summary: Keep existing app identity, state, product and room authorities. The map is a lookup projection, not another runtime.
records.use_when: Look here for runtime integration and product-aware intake.
records.adoption_gate: Exact source lineage, permitted use and consumer parity reviewed before adoption.

records.title: Canyon Museum provenance lineage
records.summary: Preserve the historical repository and branch-specific work; exact copies do not establish redundant history.
records.use_when: Trace original build recipes and references before replacing a product model.
records.adoption_gate: Exact source lineage, permitted use and consumer parity reviewed before adoption.

records.title: Bellagio / Vegas / Luxor reconstruction

records.use_when: Reuse reconstruction/build patterns and resolve current world routes before creating another environment.
records.adoption_gate: Exact source lineage, permitted use and consumer parity reviewed before adoption.

records.title: Kona Island and outdoor world
records.summary: Treat an island as a world with terrain, zones and residency; a procedural preview is not a finished room.

records.use_when: Read the authority manifest before changing site geometry, camera or representation.
records.adoption_gate: Exact source lineage, permitted use and consumer parity reviewed before adoption.

records.title: Spatial Lab prototype
records.summary: The authenticated review/XR prototype exists on a feature branch. Historical checks are not current authenticated-device acceptance.
records.use_when: Inspect the prototype and its evidence limits before implementing another review workbench.
records.adoption_gate: Exact source lineage, permitted use and consumer parity reviewed before adoption.

records.title: Shared procedural generator library

records.adoption_gate: Exact source lineage, permitted use and consumer parity reviewed before adoption.

records.title: Existing unified 3D research programme
records.summary: PR 114 includes contracts, research and runtime/benchmark changes; it is not docs-only and remains unmerged.
records.use_when: Reuse the existing research definitions by pointer; selectively reconcile code and contracts rather than mass-merging.
records.adoption_gate: Exact source lineage, permitted use and consumer parity reviewed before adoption.

records.title: Asset intake and destination budgets
records.summary: Stable identity, representation, semantic parts, provenance and mobile-load impact are separate acceptance requirements.
records.use_when: Use when integrating an existing or generated model.
records.adoption_gate: Run the source workflow and inspect its required evidence; this pointer is not an executed acceptance result.

records.title: Reference-calibrated bike production
records.summary: Use generation-specific adapters and source/reference hashes; a side mask is not independent 3D metrology.
records.use_when: Use for a new bike generation or variant; start from one class end to end.
records.adoption_gate: Run the source workflow and inspect its required evidence; this pointer is not an executed acceptance result.

records.title: Room composition without a second runtime
records.summary: Reuse the existing room skill, host renderer, interaction and state authorities.
records.use_when: Use the existing skill; this index does not install another room skill.
records.adoption_gate: Run the source workflow and inspect its required evidence; this pointer is not an executed acceptance result.

records.title: Procedural recipe to GLB and build metadata
records.summary: The shared library exporter produces output and per-asset metadata, but does not apply KONA mobile acceptance gates.
records.use_when: Resolve a recipe ID, inspect parameters, export in an isolated Blender worker and apply destination intake.
records.adoption_gate: Run the source workflow and inspect its required evidence; this pointer is not an executed acceptance result.

records.title: Derived architecture render workflow
records.summary: Place/time, scanned PBR provenance, camera and finishing disclosures belong to the derived render lineage.
records.use_when: Use a preserved derived copy and low-cost previews; do not overwrite canonical geometry.
records.adoption_gate: Run the source workflow and inspect its required evidence; this pointer is not an executed acceptance result.

records.title: Game/LOD exports
records.summary: Export levels and metadata must preserve semantic parts and state exactly; export success alone is not engine integration.
records.use_when: Use the existing export path and declare missing rig/collision/texture or integration work.
records.adoption_gate: Run the source workflow and inspect its required evidence; this pointer is not an executed acceptance result.

records.title: Studio render acceptance
records.summary: Actual rendered frames, mobile/desktop evidence and correct deployed version are required.
records.use_when: Use the existing acceptance checklist rather than static file presence.
records.adoption_gate: Run the source workflow and inspect its required evidence; this pointer is not an executed acceptance result.

records.title: Controlled performance experiment
records.summary: Pin scene, camera, device, runtime, sample conditions and source; keep visual parity independent of speed.
records.use_when: Select one benchmark with a valid baseline before optimizing.
records.adoption_gate: Run the source workflow and inspect its required evidence; this pointer is not an executed acceptance result.

records.title: Validate mesh placement beyond pivots
records.summary: A parent transform may be applied twice while object pivots still look correct. Check exported world-space geometry bounds and anchors.
records.use_when: When replacing or reparenting components, validate mesh centres against axle/BB anchors.
records.adoption_gate: Reproduce and test the serialized artifact; the existing bike check is not a universal mesh validator.

records.title: Numerical consistency is not measurement accuracy
records.summary: The 0.02 mm threshold is a consistency check against constructed bike targets. It does not establish real-world accuracy, hidden widths or manufacturing fitness.
records.use_when: State source uncertainty and independent measurement limits.
records.adoption_gate: Never convert a regression tolerance or silhouette overlap into a blanket accuracy claim.

records.title: Required fields do not prove evidence
records.summary: The current asset schema has shallow provenance/LOD/performance objects; validated labels do not bind themselves to immutable artifacts or tests.
records.use_when: Inspect nested requirements and actual receipts before promotion.
records.adoption_gate: Extend the existing contract through reviewed migration; do not fork AssetSpec.

records.title: A room name does not identify its final authored variant
records.summary: R1 recovery explicitly identifies different source generations and warns against copying a divergent runtime wholesale.
records.use_when: Resolve exact scene variant, required source/data/assets and visual baseline before wiring.
records.adoption_gate: Selective source recovery, visual parity and current runtime checks.

records.title: Infrastructure failure is not a measured runtime failure
records.summary: The inspected R1 journey job stopped because a referenced module was missing; migration replay stopped before RLS tests on missing config.
records.use_when: Validate workflow inputs before expensive setup; label blocked checks distinctly.
records.adoption_gate: Re-run the actual checks on the corrected branch. Historical R1 logs do not describe current main.

records.title: Do not invent root causes from aggregate telemetry
records.summary: Historical public error counts lack stack traces; the remediation document explicitly declines individual retrospective root-cause assignment.
records.use_when: Record coarse impact and uncertainty; collect reproducible source-specific evidence.
records.adoption_gate: A causal record needs a reproducible case or direct log support.

records.title: Rendered UI state can contradict a successful renderer
records.summary: Spatial Lab evidence reports active WebGL plus a visible fallback caused by CSS overriding hidden state, with short-landscape action sizing issues.
records.use_when: Test actual visible fallback and controls on the named viewport/device.
records.adoption_gate: Current rendered-state evidence, not the existence of responsive CSS.

records.title: Thin-glass shader recipe needs destination review
records.summary: Shared Cycles notes report transmission and shadow-ray treatment improved glazing; it is an artistic recipe with rendering assumptions.
records.use_when: Inspect the pinned recipe for cases/shopfronts; treat WebGL transfer as a hypothesis.
records.adoption_gate: Target-renderer visual review; do not use artistic shadow bypass as physical-lighting certification.

records.title: Flatten wet normals before relying on a coat reflection
records.summary: The shared render notes report a wet mask, low coat roughness and reduced bump improved puddle reflections.
records.use_when: Prototype the existing recipe on one surface rather than reauthoring a whole material system.
records.adoption_gate: Compare target-renderer captures; preserve base material and frame budget.

records.title: Bounded atmosphere avoids an observed black volume failure
records.summary: The Gaudi notes report an unbounded world volume rendered black while a bounded haze cube was controllable.
records.use_when: Inspect volume bounds and density before increasing samples or rerendering unchanged input.
records.adoption_gate: A target-engine preview must support the proposed correction.

records.title: World-scale object projection can help imported geometry
records.summary: Reported render improvements combined scanned PBR, real-scale box projection and procedural wear; imported UV behavior still needs review.
records.use_when: Reuse the documented material/provenance pipeline and inspect scale on imported context.
records.adoption_gate: Texture rights, source hashes, target renderer and no alteration of factual geometry claims.

records.title: Bound expensive render iteration
records.summary: The render notes recommend small previews and one Blender process on a small CPU worker. Timings are hardware-specific historical observations.
records.use_when: Resolve geometry/material questions with one small preview before paying final-render cost.
records.adoption_gate: Measure on the actual worker; do not present historical timings as current performance.

records.title: Shaders cannot repair a missing architectural silhouette
records.summary: The playbook reports massing-level Sagrada geometry and procedural figures constrain close-up realism.
records.use_when: Budget a permitted geometry/detail source or choose honest framing before polishing shaders.
records.adoption_gate: Any geometric enrichment needs the project authority and accurate disclosure.

records.title: Recipe counts and committed model blobs measure different things
records.summary: The pinned procedural registry has 66 definitions; older documents mention 27 components and 58 assets. Keep these source/time/set distinctions.
records.use_when: Derive current recipe counts from the registry; count output bytes and accepted assets separately.
records.adoption_gate: No claimed output acceptance or commercial clearance from recipe presence.

records.title: Procedural props are candidates, not automatically approved runtime assets
records.summary: The shared README reports a white-block contact-sheet issue for sofa_two_seat and says destination mobile gating is not applied.
records.use_when: Inspect the actual GLB/materials and apply destination budgets before use.
records.adoption_gate: Actual export and consumer visual/technical review.

records.title: Blender shading and GLB deliver different representations
records.summary: Procedural Cycles noise is not automatically a baked PBR texture pack, and a successful export does not establish game integration.
records.use_when: Preserve the editable source and explicitly inspect or bake required portable material behavior.
records.adoption_gate: Compare the serialized model in the actual viewer.

records.title: Share mesh variants instead of cloning every repeated prop
records.summary: The shared generator documentation uses linked variants and per-object material variation to preserve reuse.
records.use_when: Inspect shared mesh/material ownership before copying or applying destructive transforms.
records.adoption_gate: Measure scene cost and retain correct per-instance appearance/interaction.

records.title: A camera label is not proof of source-context promotion
records.summary: The Gaudi authority distinguishes live revision and municipal candidates; a selected camera alone does not reconcile source context.
records.use_when: Resolve source/context hashes, collections and CRS alongside camera identity.
records.adoption_gate: Explicit scene promotion plus reviewed context/evidence gates.

records.title: Reuse before creation
records.summary: The new map adds curated pointers and lessons to existing pre-create lookup. Product, room, storage and renderer authorities remain in their existing files.
records.use_when: Search the current lookup and source documents before creating a new implementation.
records.adoption_gate: Review the existing authority and scope before adoption.

records.title: Separate preservation from consolidation
records.summary: Capture irreplaceable source without waiting for a full taxonomy or deduplication project. Deduplication requires consumer, provenance and permission review.
records.use_when: Capture source/dependencies first; retain all provenance occurrences.
records.adoption_gate: Review the existing authority and scope before adoption.

records.title: Prove one class end to end
records.summary: A bounded asset-class loop limits adapter and validator scope; cross-class generalization is a later controlled experiment.
records.use_when: Complete source, export, integration and evidence for one class before adding a second active production path.
records.adoption_gate: Review the existing authority and scope before adoption.

records.title: Do not defer safety until platform extraction
records.summary: Fresh-checkout correctness, allowed use, required release tests and source preservation remain prerequisites for the affected delivery.
records.use_when: Repair blockers that affect the chosen slice; defer unrelated platform polish.
records.adoption_gate: Review the existing authority and scope before adoption.

records.title: Public technical projection only
records.summary: This curated map is not a replacement for private knowledge stores or a new asset/world schema. Confidential provider and workstation evidence stays outside the public repository.
records.use_when: Keep only sanitized technical pointers and scoped observations here.
records.adoption_gate: Review the existing authority and scope before adoption.

records.title: Editable source restore remains a separate gate
records.summary: Source export and checksum verification alone do not verify linked resources or a clean Blender/application restore.
records.use_when: Resolve this gate for the actual affected delivery.
records.adoption_gate: Keep unresolved work visible; no automatic promotion.

records.title: R1 remains unmerged research
records.summary: Map current main implementation against the original drafts before changing AssetSpec, world routing or runtime code.
